MultimodalQwen38Loader.description: Loads a local Qwen3.8 GGUF model and its vision projector with CUDA llama.cpp.

model_file.name: model file
model_file.tooltip: Main Qwen3.8 GGUF model file. Q4_K_M is the current 32 GB VRAM baseline.

mmproj_file.name: vision projector
mmproj_file.tooltip: Multimodal projector GGUF required for image and video-frame understanding.

thinking_mode.name: thinking mode
thinking_mode.tooltip: Thinking enables internal reasoning; instruct is faster and more direct.

context_length.name: context length
context_length.tooltip: Maximum prompt plus response token window. Larger values reserve more KV-cache memory.

batch_size.name: batch size
batch_size.tooltip: Prompt-processing batch size. Higher can be faster but uses more VRAM.

micro_batch_size.name: micro batch size
micro_batch_size.tooltip: Physical llama.cpp micro-batch size. Reduce this first if prompt processing runs out of VRAM.

gpu_layers.name: GPU layers
gpu_layers.tooltip: Layers offloaded to GPU. -1 means all layers and is recommended for the RTX 5090.

free_comfy_vram.name: free ComfyUI VRAM
free_comfy_vram.tooltip: Unload ComfyUI diffusion models before loading this large local VLM.

0.name: backend
0.tooltip: Loaded local multimodal model backend for the Multimodel Chat node.

1.name: backend info
1.tooltip: Resolved model, context, GPU layers, mode, and load time.

MultimodalAPIEnv.description: Sends one simple text or multi-image request using an API key from an environment variable.

base_url.name: base URL
base_url.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible API base URL; do not include /chat/completions.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: Exact model ID exposed by the API provider.

api_key_env.name: API key environment variable
api_key_env.tooltip: Environment variable containing the API key, for example OPENAI_API_KEY.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: Text instruction sent to the API; an IMAGE batch can be sent with it.

max_tokens.name: max output tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum output tokens. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Sampling temperature. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. Providers that support seed can use it for repeatable sampling.

system_prompt.name: system prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Optional system instruction; leave blank for provider defaults.

image.name: optional image batch
image.tooltip: One image or an IMAGE batch; every batch item is sent in the same API request.

max_image_edge.name: max image edge
max_image_edge.tooltip: Resize each image before upload so its longest edge does not exceed this value.

max_image_frames.name: max images
max_image_frames.tooltip: Maximum number of images taken from the IMAGE batch for this request.

1.name: usage
1.tooltip: Token usage JSON returned by the provider, when available.

MultimodalAPIDirect.description: Sends one simple text or multi-image request using a key entered in the node.

base_url.name: base URL
base_url.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible API base URL; do not include /chat/completions.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: Exact model ID exposed by the API provider.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: Text instruction sent to the API; an IMAGE batch can be sent with it.

max_tokens.name: max output tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum output tokens. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Sampling temperature. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. Providers that support seed can use it for repeatable sampling.

system_prompt.name: system prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Optional system instruction; leave blank for provider defaults.

image.name: optional image batch
image.tooltip: One image or an IMAGE batch; every batch item is sent in the same API request.

max_image_edge.name: max image edge
max_image_edge.tooltip: Resize each image before upload so its longest edge does not exceed this value.

max_image_frames.name: max images
max_image_frames.tooltip: Maximum number of images taken from the IMAGE batch for this request.

api_key.name: API key
api_key.tooltip: API key used for this request; environment variables are not read.

1.name: usage

MultimodalChat.description: Sends text, images, or video to either a local model or an OpenAI-compatible API backend.

backend.name: backend
backend.tooltip: Connect a Multimodel local loader or API backend.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: User instruction sent with the attached image/video content.

thinking_mode.name: thinking mode
thinking_mode.tooltip: Use backend setting, force reasoning mode, or force direct instruct mode.

max_tokens.name: max tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum number of new text tokens to generate.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Sampling randomness. Lower values are steadier; higher values are more varied.

top_p.name: top P
top_p.tooltip: Nucleus sampling threshold. 0.95 is a strong general default.

top_k.name: top K
top_k.tooltip: Restrict each token choice to the top K candidates. 0 disables it when supported.

min_p.name: min P
min_p.tooltip: Discard tokens whose probability is too small relative to the best token.

repeat_penalty.name: repeat penalty
repeat_penalty.tooltip: Penalizes repeated text. 1.0 disables the penalty.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed used for reproducible sampling when all other inputs match. ComfyUI can keep, increment, decrement, or randomize it after generation.

max_image_edge.name: max image edge
max_image_edge.tooltip: Resize each image/frame so its longest edge is at most this many pixels.

max_image_frames.name: max image frames
max_image_frames.tooltip: Maximum number of IMAGE-batch items to send as still images.

max_video_frames.name: max video frames
max_video_frames.tooltip: Maximum number of evenly sampled video frames sent to the model.

video_transport.name: video transport
video_transport.tooltip: API video mode: native data URL when supported, or sampled frames. Local models always use frames.

unload_after.name: unload after
unload_after.tooltip: Release this backend after generation. Enable to recover VRAM, disable for faster repeated chats.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: One image or an IMAGE batch of still images.

video_frames.name: video frames
video_frames.tooltip: Decoded video frames as a ComfyUI IMAGE batch.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: ComfyUI VIDEO object; locally it is sampled into frames.

tools_json.name: tools JSON
tools_json.tooltip: Optional OpenAI function/tool schema as one JSON object or an array.

0.name: response
0.tooltip: Final assistant answer without hidden reasoning tags.

1.name: reasoning
1.tooltip: Reasoning text when the backend exposes it.

2.name: raw response
2.tooltip: Raw assistant content or complete tool-call message.

3.name: stats
3.tooltip: Timing, token, speed, media-count, and backend statistics.

MultimodalUnload.description: Explicitly unloads a local model or closes an API client.

backend.name: backend
backend.tooltip: Backend instance to unload or close.
